task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: First navigate to the FRONT_CRATE, pick it up, navigate to TEMP_ZONE, place it there, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, place the bottle on the table.
assumptions: The FRONT_CRATE is considered the obstacle in front of the CAR.
The robot can grasp the FRONT_CRATE and MEDICINE_BOTTLE (they are graspable).
The starting robot position is near the CAR's coordinates.
The MEDICINE_BOTTLE and FRONT_CRATE are within interaction distance after navigation.
The MEDICAL_TABLE is a valid location to place an object.
